_comment: Maps current EIA utility ID to predecessor IDs that covered the same territory in earlier years. The build script backfills missing years from predecessor data. Edit this file to add/remove mappings, then re-run build_eia_timeseries_json.py. Run generate_predecessor_candidates.py to find more candidates.

17671151TX.note: Kinder Morgan Tejas Pipeline LLC TX (2004+). Renamed from LP to LLC in 2004.

17676012MN.note: Minnesota Energy Resources Corp MN (own filings 2013+). MERC filed as two divisions until 2012 and as one entity afterwards: MINNESOTA ENERGY RESOURCES - NMU (35,817 customers) and MERC PNG (155,127), which together are 190,944 against the 191,350 the combined filer reports for 2013 - a ratio of 0.998. Only NMU had been mapped, which accounted for under a fifth of the utility. Residential volume alone looks like a 0.76 mismatch because 2012 was an exceptionally warm winter (70 Mcf per customer) and 2013 cold (92), so customer counts are the reliable check here.

_section_ri_consolidation: Rhode Island gas utilities consolidated under National Grid / Narragansett Electric around 2001-2002

17698114RI.note: Narragansett Electric Co Gas Div RI (2002+). National Grid consolidated Rhode Island gas distribution utilities in 2001-2002. New England Gas Co (then a Southern Union subsidiary), Valley Gas Co, and Bristol Warren Gas Co all ceased individual reporting in 2000-2001 when their service territories were absorbed into Narragansett Electric's gas division.

_section_pa_ugi_consolidation: UGI acquired PPL Gas Utilities, which had merged North Penn Gas and Penn Fuel Gas

17671661PA.note: UGI Central Penn Gas Inc PA (2005-2017). North Penn Gas Co and Penn Fuel Gas Inc (PFG Gas Inc) merged into PPL Gas Utilities Corporation effective December 31, 2004; UGI then acquired PPL Gas Utilities in 2008 and reorganized the combined entity as UGI Central Penn Gas Inc. In January 2019 UGI merged Central Penn Gas and Penn Natural Gas into UGI Utilities is NOT listed as a source: Central Penn merged INTO it in 2018, so filling Central Penn's later years from its parent made this entry read 512,116 customers against its own 70,171 — a 7x overstatement. Central Penn's series simply ends; the combined system is reported under UGI Utilities.

_section_centerpoint_intrastate: CenterPoint Energy Intrastate descended from PanEnergy via Duke Energy reorganization

17671025LA.note: CenterPoint Energy Intrastate PL LLC LA (2004+). PanEnergy Corp merged with Duke Energy in 1997, absorbing PanEnergy Louisiana Intrastate LLC. After CenterPoint Energy was spun off from Reliant Energy in 2002, the Louisiana intrastate pipeline assets came under CenterPoint Energy Intrastate Pipelines LLC.

_section_known_acquisitions: Confirmed acquisitions where names differ — verified from company history

17670317OH.note: East Ohio Gas Comp Dominion East OH (2000+). Dominion Resources acquired East Ohio Gas Company around 2000 and renamed it.

17694131OH.note: Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio (2002+). Same company as 'Vectren of Ohio', name extended after Vectren Corp reorganization.

17640418MO.note: Missouri Gas Energy MO (2004+). Southern Union Company operated Missouri distribution under the Missouri Gas Energy brand.

17696331IA.note: Interstate Power and Light IA (own filings 2002+). Alliant merged Interstate Power Co (30,901 customers) and IES Utilities (159,041) into IPL in 2002; together 189,942 against the 191,268 IPL reports for 2002, a ratio of 0.993. Only Interstate Power Co had been mapped, about a sixth of the utility. IES stops at 2000 because of the truncated 2001 EIA source year, so 2001 is a partial sum and is skipped.

17675803NH.note: Liberty Utilities DBA Energy North NH (2012+). Liberty Utilities acquired EnergyNorth Inc.'s NH gas distribution operations.

17692927MO.note: Atmos Energy Corporation MO (2004+). Atmos acquired United Cities Gas Company in 1997, which had MO operations.

17671155AR.note: Black Hills Energy AR (2016+). Black Hills Corp acquired Source Gas Holdings in 2016, which included Arkansas Western Gas operations. Two predecessor IDs for same territory.

17680531MA.note: Eversource Gas Co of MA (2020+). Formerly Columbia Gas of Massachusetts; NiSource sold the MA distribution business to Eversource in 2020 following the 2018 Merrimack Valley gas explosions.

17673850NM.note: New Mexico Gas Company (2009+). Formerly PNM Gas Services; PNM Resources sold its natural gas distribution business (renamed New Mexico Gas Company) in 2008/2009.

17671862IL.note: Ameren Illinois. 1997-2004 is the SUM of its three Illinois gas utilities, none of them alone. For 2006-2009 Ameren filed only one division (~170k customers) while the other two still filed separately, so those years are ADDITIVE: its own figure plus the predecessors still reporting. That lands at 745-773k against 745,105 in 2010, its first year filing the whole system. 2005 is deliberately left out of the additive window — all three predecessors filed that year as well, so adding Ameren's own would double-count to ~905k against a true ~733k.

17600343WV.note: Mountaineer Gas Company; same utility filed as "Mountaineer Gas Co" under a different EIA id.

17618300IN.note: Ohio Valley Gas Inc; same utility filed as "Ohio Valley Gas Corp" under a different EIA id.

17680615KY.note: Atmos Energy Corporation KY; identical name, new EIA id.

17698926AZ.note: UNS Gas Inc AZ (2003+). UniSource acquired Citizens' Arizona gas operations in 2003. 2003 is filed THREE ways: UNS itself reports 42,079 residential customers while both Citizens filers report that year too, 72,869 and 3,735. Summed they give 118,683 against 118,617 for 2004 — within 0.06% — so 2003 is additive, not a handover. Shown alone, UNS read about a third of the utility, which is what produced its 2004 shelf.

17672421MO.note: Empire District Gas MO (2006+). Empire District acquired Aquila Missouri gas operations in 2006; continuity 1.09.

17676062MO.note: Summit Natural Gas of Missouri. Two predecessors, not one: Southern Missouri Gas (8,321 residential customers at 2011) and Missouri Gas Utility (2,395), both ending 2011, the year before Summit's own filings begin. With only the first mapped, 1997-2011 read 8,321 against 11,337 in 2012; summed they give 10,716, and Summit grew steadily to 12,702 the following year.

17619858KY.note: Delta Natural Gas KY main filer (1997-2023). In 2023 it absorbed the small segment that had filed separately as 17676572KY (customers went 31,289 -> 34,220), and from 2024 the combined utility files under 17676572KY. That id is windowed to 2024+ so it supplies only the later years and is not mistaken for a predecessor of the earlier ones.

17614088PA.note: UGI Utilities, which holds the UGI CENTRAL PENN GAS territory. Central Penn and Penn Natural Gas merged into it in 2018: UGI's own residential customers step 291,758 -> 504,954 that year, and 291,758 + Central Penn 68,582 + Penn Natural Gas 147,134 = 507,474, within 0.5% of it. So 1997-2017 is ADDITIVE — UGI's own filing plus both subsidiaries — which makes one continuous series for the footprint the polygon actually covers, instead of a 1.7x step at the merger.
